name: KIC 4824985
description: A red-clump giant burning helium in its core in the Kepler field, 11.3 solar radii and 0.95 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 4824985 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 11.2509 +/- 0.1992

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 4824985 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 0.9475 +/- 0.0369

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 4824985 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4625.9746 +/- 56.9987

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 4824985 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 2.315 +/- 0.0045

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the colour routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red-clump giant in the Kepler field, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 0.95 solar masses and 11.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,626 K at its surface.

radialVelocity.source: No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 2101285540957271168 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 1,000,000 of its distance per century
